H1.note: the chain starts twice: at the IL23R risk haplotype (H1.1) and at IL12B (H1.2). The IL12B risk alleles rs755374, rs6556412 and the protective IL23R allele rs11209026 appear only in the mechanism and the evidence lists, never as a chain subject, so they get no claim here

H2.note: the chain starts twice: at the NOD2 variant rs2066847 (H2.1) and at LACC1 (H2.2). 'Impaired NOD2-LACC1 signalling degrades bacterial handling' makes LACC1 protective, so the LACC1 claim is negative

H3.note: the run calls both variants 'Crohn risk variants', so each claims a raised risk. The title says GPR35's own direction of effect is unresolved, so there is no gene-level GPR35 claim

findings.detail: H1.1 ends at 'IL-23 receptor signalling in mucosal T cells' and H1.2 restarts at IL12B, so the IL23R haplotype never reaches Crohn disease and its claim has no route
H1.2 ends at Th17 lineage commitment and IL-23 production, H1.3 starts at IL-17 production; bridged (B1) only because GO defines a Th17 cell as one that produces IL-17

H1 is rated high confidence, yet none of the 13 citations on its steps states a step: they are variant-disease associations, drug indications that name no target, an interaction edge, an Il23r-null colitis annotation and three over-representation results (the one v1 kept, STRING:GO:2000330, is now excluded as enrichment)
nothing cited says the IL23R risk haplotype raises receptor signalling; the direction comes from the run's own note that loss of receptor function is protective, which no cited text states
neither half of H1.2 has a supporting text: the Th17 record is a STRING over-representation result for IL12B and IL23R, and nothing cited mentions IL-23 heterodimer formation or IL-23 production
IL-17 production to Crohn disease has no supporting text: the cited p40/p19 antibody indications and the Il23r-null colitis record bear on IL-23, not on IL-17

H1's three contradicting citations state nothing against a step: OT:IL23R-safety lists adenoma and paradoxical psoriasiform reactions, NCT07697456 is a recruiting trial with no results, and CHEMBL:no-mechanism-IL23R says no drug acts on IL23R, which undercuts the title's 'validated drug axis' for the receptor but not any step
increases_amount and decreases_amount are used with process objects (IL-23 receptor signalling; NOD2 signalling and autophagy); rendered as process targets

five steps have a two-part object; each is split into two statements, and in v2 every half is expressed (IL-23 heterodimer formation as GO interleukin-23 production, mesenteritis as inflammatory response refined to the mesentery in Crohn disease)
the run's own NOD2 discovery paper PMID:11385576 suggests the Crohn variants act by over-activating NF-kB, the opposite of the loss of signalling in H2.1
no citation shows rs2066847 lowers NOD2 signalling or autophagy: the GWAS records give only disease association and UniProt describes wild-type NOD2
H2.1 ends at NOD2 signalling/autophagy and H2.2 restarts at LACC1; nothing links the NOD2 variant's effect to bacterial handling, so the rs2066847 claim has no route
H2.3 (LACC1 in colon macrophages associated with Crohn disease) links neither neighbour; H2.4 joins H2.2 only by reading 'defective bacterial handling' as the negation of 'bacterial clearance'

none of the three citations states 'defective myeloid bacterial handling raises Crohn disease', and PMID:29538758 says no specific mechanistic link exists between NOD2, PLCG2 and LACC1, against H2's convergence thesis

PMID:27478939, cited on H2.2, says the LACC1 coding variants are loss-of-function and raise Crohn risk: a direct signed LACC1 to Crohn link the chain never uses, routing through an expression association (H2.3) instead

the only direction in H2.3's own citation is more LACC1 in Crohn than normal colon macrophages (17.3% vs 12.4%), the opposite of H2's thesis that LACC1 protects; the run calls the polarity unknown and notes the groups come from separate studies, yet keeps the step in the causal chain. Curated on a colon-macrophage refinement, it does not compose into the LACC1 arm; with the qualifier dropped it would be a sign-flipped arm

contradicting PMID:40089498 shows Crohn risk alleles lower LACC1 expression in CD4+ T cells and LACC1 knockdown reduces Treg differentiation: it fits H2's loss-of-function direction but places the effect in T cells, and it runs against H2.3's higher-in-Crohn macrophage signal; the run names it only in the falsification test
OT:LACC1-tractability is listed as contradicting H2, but its function text is UniProt's 'promotes optimal NOD2-induced signaling, cytokine secretion and bacterial clearance', which supports H2.2

HPA:ENSG00000179630 (LACC1 low tissue specificity, highest in cardiomyocytes) is listed as contradicting H2; an expression level that bears on no step's direction, though it does not place LACC1 in macrophages
H2 lists STRING:NOD2-LACC1 (text-mining only, experimental 0.00) in both supporting_evidence and contradicting_evidence; H3 does the same with CHEMBL:no-mechanism-GPR35

H3.1 goes straight from the variants to Crohn disease and no step says which way the variants move GPR35; H3.2 shares GPR35 with H3.3 and kynurenic acid with H3.4, but binding has no sign, and neither H3.3 (GPR35 to colitis) nor H3.4 (kynurenic acid to Crohn colitis and mesenteritis) is reachable from the variants, so the mechanism cannot compose even in principle
PMID:28658209 (IBD fine-mapping) names neither GPR35 nor either variant, and rs34236350's GWAS row has no effect allele, so that variant's association stays unsigned and its claim has no route

the step and title claim an epithelium-intrinsic colonocyte effect, but the only signed evidence is whole-body Gpr35 mutant mice; expression in colonocytes does not show where the effect acts, as the run's own falsification test admits

H3's title calls GPR35's direction unresolved and H3.3's note names the opposing allele, yet H3.3 is written as a positive required_for (GPR35 protects); with the run's contradicting citations now fetched, H3_3b has one supporting (em1Niess, more colitis) and two refuting (tm1(KOMP)Vlcg, less colitis and less colitis-induced morbidity/mortality) mouse records

GPR35 single-cell detection in Crohn vs normal colon goes up in epithelial cells (6.2% vs 2.7%) and enterocytes (4.9% vs 3.4%) but down in stem cells (0.81% vs 2.8%); the run cites the first two as support and the third as contradiction, though all three compare separate studies
PMID:36076306 is about stem cells primed with KYNA and IFN-gamma acting through IDO-1, not a kynurenic acid-GPR35 axis in the host

the run's note says PMID:40623474 does not prove the effect is GPR35-dependent, but the re-fetched abstract states 'KYNA induced MAT browning and regulated disease procession of CD via GPR35-ERK1/2-PGC-1α signaling pathway'; the doubt may be fair, but it is not in the cited text

supporting citations at no step state none: R-HSA-447115 (IL-12 family over-representation), OT:IL12B-MONDO_0005011 and OT:IL23R-MONDO_0005011 (scores), CHEMBL:CHEMBL3990029-EFO_0000384 (a phase 3 indication naming no target), PMID:21102463 (a Crohn GWAS meta-analysis naming none of the run's genes)

supporting citations at no step state none: rs2076756 (another NOD2 variant's Crohn association), AGR:MGI:2429397:MP:0008713 (Nod2-null 'abnormal cytokine level', no direction), OT:NOD2-MONDO_0005011 and OT:LACC1-MONDO_0005011 (scores); STRING:NOD2-LACC1 is judged under H2.2 as a contradicting citation

of H3's supporting citations at no step, OT:GPR35-tractability carries UniProt's function text and states H3.2 (attached there); CXG:ENSG00000178623:CL_0000584:MONDO_0005011 (enterocyte detection rate), CHEMBL:target-CHEMBL1293267 and CHEMBL:no-mechanism-GPR35 state no step
every chain subject and object except Crohn disease and the GPR35 protein in H3.2 has an empty CURIE, and kinds are loose: haplotypes, variants and 'LACC1 expression' are all kind gene
a haplotype of two named alleles has no form; recorded as a single BLN variant with a label, losing that it is a pair
no identifier for the IL23R two-allele risk haplotype; made BLN:IL23R-risk-haplotype-rs7517847A-rs11465804T (a variant class, label only)

no corpus disease or phenotype term for mesenteritis (creeping fat) except IgG4-related mesenteritis; expressed as GO:0006954 inflammatory response refined to UBERON:0002095 mesentery in Crohn disease, which chains only where another step uses the same refinement

a GWAS row with a signed beta (0.1795, increase, p=1e-32) but an unreported effect allele ('?') can only be an unsigned association, since a dbSNP entity stands for one allele; the strongest GPR35 signal in the run cannot compose
the same UniProt function text arrives through two records (Q9HC97 and OT:GPR35-tractability; Q8IV20 and OT:LACC1-tractability), and nothing marks two records as one source, so H3.2 counts it twice
a CELLxGENE detection-rate difference between cells from separate diseased and normal studies enters as ordinary observational evidence; there is no way to mark a batch-confounded comparison
a citation the run lists as contradicting but whose text supports the step (OT:LACC1-tractability) can only be excluded as 'other'; there is no polarity or category for it

AGR:MGI:1929509:MP:0013299 (decreased susceptibility to colitis-induced morbidity/mortality) is about outcome, a progression aspect, but refutes H3_3b, whose target is colitis risk; evidence carries no aspect of its own

H3's mechanism calls GPR35 'colonocyte-dominant in HPA' and H3.3's subject is GPR35 in colonocytes, but the cited HPA record ranks enterocytes highest (124.5 nCPM) above colonocytes (88.9 nCPM); only the record's one-line summary, which the run repeated, lists colonocytes first

H2's mechanism says single-cell colon data 'place LACC1 predominantly in macrophages', but the cited CELLxGENE record reports one cell type only (macrophages, 17.3% vs 12.4%), so it cannot rank cell types; the HPA record the run lists as contradicting puts LACC1's single-cell peak in cardiomyocytes
the cited GWAS row for rs2066847 gives odds ratio 3.103 with an interval of 1.497-1.618 that does not contain it; H2's mechanism quotes 'OR 3.10' without noting the mismatch

Q8IV20, kept for H2_2a, says LACC1 'promotes optimal NOD2-induced signaling, cytokine secretion' but also that through L-ornithine it controls polyamine pools 'likely triggering polyamine-mediated proinflammatory cytokine suppression'; the run cites only the first, and one record cannot be kept as both support and refutation of one statement

H3_3b's two refuting records, MP:0008539 and MP:0013299, are two MGI annotations of one genotype (Gpr35 tm1(KOMP)Vlcg) from one paper (PMID:33990686), so one study counts twice against the one em1Niess study supporting it (belief 4/13, disbelief 8/13); nothing groups annotations by their source paper
